title: tkr script result envelope
description: The JSON envelope every `tkr script` subcommand writes to stdout with --json, in both success and failure (docs/spec/engine/rpgcode-tooling.md#tool-9). Exit codes are stable and public once published; adding an optional field is a minor change, removing or retyping one, or adding an exit code, is a major one.

tool.description: The binary that produced the envelope. One binary serves every group.

subcommand.description: The script group subcommand that ran.

status.description: Agrees with exitCode: ok for 0, findings for 1, error for 2 and 3.

exitCode.description: 0 nothing to report, 1 findings in the project, 2 usage or configuration error, 3 internal error.

diagnostics.description: The diagnostic objects of TOOL-3, in the order the tool produced them: failures and lint findings together, so an editor and a CI job see one shape.

changed.description: Files fmt would change, or did change.

results.description: The subcommand's own payload: changed paths for fmt, cases with expected and actual for test, the written path or a drift list for docs, the TOOL-6 document for index, and an empty object for check.

position.description: A source position in decoded characters: lines and columns 1-based, the column inclusive.

range.description: A half-open source range, start inclusive and end exclusive.

textEdit.description: One replacement of a source range with new text, naming the rule that produced it.

diagnostic.description: TOOL-3: one diagnostic from the parser, the linter or the engine's run.

code.description: A failure code such as syntax.error, or a lint rule id such as lint/unused-variable.

rule.description: The lint rule id when a rule raised the diagnostic; absent for a parser diagnostic.

file.description: The program's path as the tool names it.

fix.description: The autofix, when the rule has a safe rewrite.
